title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
slides: Can you trust the AI agents you hire?
Most companies can't even audit their agents.
Now you can test agents before deployment.
Action: audit your agents before next quarter.
thread_text:
1. Who's auditing your AI?

Most firms can't even trace what their agents do. AIR just raised $50M to fix that blind spot.

2. The $50M question

AIR's fund verifies agent skills before you hire them. But most companies still deploy unverified agents today.

3. Audit before you deploy

Now you can test agents pre-launch. Skip the trial-and-error phase that costs real money and trust.

4. The hidden cost

Unchecked agents erode customer confidence silently. A failed audit today beats a public failure tomorrow.

5. Your move

Run a basic audit on one agent this week. If you can't, that's your first red flag.

instagram.caption:
$50M just went into making sure the AI agents you hire actually do what they claim.  

Most companies can't audit their own agents today. That's the gap AIR is targeting—verifying agent skills before you deploy them, not after something breaks.  

For you, that means the difference between shipping AI that works and shipping AI that quietly erodes trust with your audience.  

If you had to run a full audit on one agent right now, would you pass? 🔍
